headline: Ayar Labs lists roles spanning RNM construction, schematic correlation, sign-off, and full-chip integration
fact: Ayar Labs listed related Bengaluru analog/mixed-signal modeling and verification roles. Their descriptions call for capturing significant first- and second-order circuit effects in SystemVerilog RNM, comparing models with schematics, signing off models, and integrating them into full-chip digital verification. The senior staff role adds model ownership through the product lifecycle. The postings name UVM and Verilog-AMS and include wreal/EEnet and optical simulation tools among preferred experience.

sources.title: Ayar Labs: Sr. Staff Engineer, Analog/Mixed Signal Modelling and Verification (696)
sources.summary: The official Ayar Labs ATS description specifies schematic-derived RNM, model comparison, sign-off, full-chip integration, lifecycle ownership, and preferred wreal/EEnet and optical-tool experience. It exposes no absolute posting date.

sources.title: Ayar Labs senior engineer listing — Insight Partners portfolio jobs
sources.summary: The investor portfolio listing dates senior engineer role 693 to August 28, 2026, and preserves its RNM construction, schematic comparison, sign-off, and full-chip integration responsibilities.

sources.title: Ayar Labs senior staff listing — Playground Global portfolio jobs
sources.summary: The investor portfolio listing dates senior staff role 696 to September 4, 2026. Together with the August senior engineer listing, it supports an August–September cluster; these are public listing dates, not independently established original ATS publication dates.
